CAMPFIRE.desc: A crackling fire where villagers gather and food cooks faster.
CAMPFIRE.name: Campfire

FARM_PLOT.desc: Tilled beds for sowing seeds. Crops ripen on real time, so a plot sown before you leave is ready when you return.
FARM_PLOT.effect: +1 planting bed per level (see Village → Farm)
FARM_PLOT.name: Farm Plot

GRANARY.desc: Boosts food production and town growth with a slow trickle of raw provisions.
GRANARY.effect: Passively produces 1 raw shrimp per cycle, per level
GRANARY.name: Granary

SAWMILL.desc: Automatically saws stray logs into construction planks over time.
SAWMILL.effect: Passively converts 1 log → 1 plank per cycle, per level
SAWMILL.name: Sawmill

SMELTER.desc: A standing furnace. Required to actively smith bars, and passively smelts spare ore.
SMELTER.effect: Unlocks Smithing recipes; passively converts ore → bars per cycle, per level
SMELTER.name: Smelter

STORAGE_BIN.desc: A humble wooden crate for extra resources — perfect for new settlers.
STORAGE_BIN.name: Storage Bin

STOREHOUSE.desc: Expands bulk resource storage so gathering runs don't cap out early.
STOREHOUSE.name: Storehouse

TOWN_HALL.desc: Seat of the settlement. Taxes citizens and extends how long the town can run while you're away.
TOWN_HALL.effect: +4h max offline idle capacity, +2 coins/tick passive tax
TOWN_HALL.name: Town Hall
